verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no product-native rules engine or event-triggered automation that a user can configure in Airwallex. Webhooks only push event notifications to your own application, so the user would have to build the triggered actions themselves; that makes them a developer building block, not the capability. AgentOS skills are agent-invoked workflows, and recurring invoices and subscriptions are fixed billing schedules rather than user-defined event rules.
